blocks.title: Graph
blocks.text: Graph aisa data structure hai jo edges se jure nodes (vertices) par mushtamil hai. Graph algorithms graphs ko khangalte aur jaanchte hain aur network analysis, raasta mansooba bandi aur social network analysis ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Graph ki shakal mein sarak ke naqshe mein nodes aur edges kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Nodes jagahein jaise shehar ya chowk; edges unhein jorne wali sarkein.

items: Graph: edges se jure nodes (vertices); networks, raaston aur social networks mein istemal.
